profile.headline: Developer Lead at Bank Of America
profile.summary: Want to work in a team of professionals where I can learn and further develop my software development skills.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Researched and developed proof of concept applications to demonstrate advantages and disadvantages of various new .NET Technologies and design strategies for design phase of complete rewrite of stress testing applications.

Migrated solutions to Visual Studio 2012 x64 platform from Visual Studio 2010 x86 and fixed any issues that arose from migration.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Created Windows Services and MVC3 Applications using C#.NET, Entity Framework 4.0 (DB First) and LINQ to manage loans in Bankruptcy process. Helped create and verify Test Scripts, created design documents and participated in project meetings. 

Enhanced Win form applications written in VB.NET that used COM api to hijack Mainframe sessions to automate loan processing.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Develop and update ASP.NET websites to create and manage requests to be submitted, approved and worked.  
Created and updated user controls and objects using object oriented programming concept.
Provided sizing estimates on all work assigned.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed and enhanced TurboTax service for 2011, data driven PDF Forms and ASP.NET and WCF based reporting application.
Created technical documentation for all work performed and participated on calls to provide status of projects.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description: Project Meetings, Sizing, Resource Assignments, Coding, Testing and Deployment of projects.

educations.schoolName: University of North Carolina at Charlotte
